items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: The first time I realized I had to make somebody else’s record was when I did the Laura Nyro “Eli” record. I met with Laura and she was very, very different.

ctx.x: Am I correct that you would not change your arranging style if you were also the producer?

This – that’s a very interesting question because up until 1968 I made Charlie Calello records. I went in and did Charlie Calello. I didn’t know I was doing it but I’d get called and I’d do this. This is what I did. The first time I realized I had to make somebody else’s record was when I did the Laura Nyro “Eli” record. I met with Laura and she was very, very different. She wrote songs where in the middle of the song the feel would change. The tempo would change. She’d slow down. She’d play songs that didn’t…
